desc: Bring the graphical desktop up on the persistent SD root (204) at maxcpus=1, which is the only clean core count. The root already has xorg-server, xf86-input-libinput, i3wm, i3status, st, dmenu, fonts, /etc/i3/config, /etc/i3status.conf and /root/.xinitrc (setxkbmap no; exec i3). Verify: X starts on the panel via startx, i3 bar shows WiFi/battery/AC/disk/clock, Super+Return opens st, Super+d opens dmenu, Norwegian keymap is active, and the keyboard backlight responds to brightnessctl. This is the last step to a genuinely usable machine at 1 core and does not depend on 205 at all. ACHIEVED 2026-08-03: after a COLD REBOOT with no console interaction, Xorg + i3bar + i3status come up automatically from the persistent SD root. i3 4.24 loaded /etc/i3/config, workspace 1 focused at 3024x1867 (native panel minus the 23px bar), root on /dev/loop0. Two bugs fixed: (1) startx/xinit exits immediately and takes X with it -- launch /usr/libexec/Xorg and i3 directly instead; (2) as an inittab ::once: entry the script races ahead of openrc hostname so xauth built display name "(none):0" and i3 could not authenticate -- the script now sets the hostname itself. Requires maxcpus=1 until ticket 205 is fixed. Doc: evidence/2026-08-03-t6040-GRAPHICAL-DESKTOP-MILESTONE.md
